summary: 1. Ore resumes after the five-day shutdown (Aug 13-17), loading 3,596 BCM against a 2,954 BCM target (+21.7%), while the total-production line clears target narrowly (+0.6%, 23,126 BCM) and waste runs 2.5% under. 2. 2. The MTD gap narrows for the first time since ore stopped — total production improves to -9.3% against target from Aug 9's -12.1%, though MTD ore itself stays deep in deficit at -15.2% with only six fiscal days left in the 31-day August cycle. 3. 3. The crusher loses 12h35m to a day-shift maintenance stop, the heaviest single-day crusher downtime since Aug 3, and still clears 1,872 BCM — stockpile-to-crusher MTD throughput sits at 60,309 LCM, 48.6% of the 124,000 LCM plan. 4. Confirm the cause of the 12h35m Aug 18 crusher maintenance stop — none of the standing fleet faults in [[fleet-availability-utilization]] currently name a crusher-side unit. 5. No new Daily Availability Final Report or survey (INX-SUM) workbook landed this pass — fleet availability holds at the 16-Aug reading (86.21% daily / 84.67% MTD) and survey reconciliation holds at Day 24 (+3.83% daily, -26.69% MTD). 6. EX-253 remained fully down all day on its standing "Swing problem" fault, open since 28-Jul. 7. DPR-Aug-2026.xlsx ties the Client Meeting Report exactly on waste and ore tons, stripping ratio 5.43. 8. Drilling for the day: 3,186 m / 269 holes / 144 samples, cross-checked clean across the drill meters and sampling workbooks. `Aug Block Info.xlsx` carries no Aug (18) tab at all — same stale layout issue tracked since the 45th pass. 9. Full detail in `RAW/_INGESTED.md`. Important References and the Task Feedback Log: not processed this pass — dashboard-scoped, per the 74th/75th/77th/80th/82nd/87th pass pattern. This run's brief is limited to the dashboard-facing production/fleet/survey articles. No update to [[fleet-availability-utilization]] or [[survey-volume-reconciliation]] this pass — no new source material for either since the 89th pass. No content removed or renamed.
